title: 15-Year-Old GhostLock Flaw Enables Root and Container Escape on Most Linux Distros
summary: Researchers at Nebula Security have disclosed GhostLock (CVE-2026-43499), a 15-year-old Linux kernel flaw that lets any logged-in user take full root control of a machine that has not been patched.

title: CISA Adds 4 Actively Exploited Adobe, Joomla, and Langflow Flaws to KEV
summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Tuesday added four security flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation.

title: CISA orders feds to patch max severity ColdFusion flaw by Friday
